pageProps.title: Jingis Hwaseong Dongtan Branch
pageProps.review: A review of a satisfying visit to Jingis, a lamb rib specialty restaurant in Dongtan, Hwaseong, Gyeonggi-do, where I tasted a lamb meat assortment without any gaminess and a unique delicacy, lamb gamjatang.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Lamb Meat Assortment", "rating": 4 } --- No smell. ``` ```menu { "title": "Lamb Gamjatang", "rating": 4 } --- Gamjatang with lamb? As expected, it's delicious. ``` ## Review The lamb doesn't smell, and they grill it well. I ordered Lamb Meat Assortment Set B, and it included lamb gamjatang. It was my first time having lamb gamjatang, and I enjoyed it satisfyingly without any particular awkwardness. ## Pictures
